decisions.reason: A core upholstery fabric with its own product page, close to the established offer and supported by a growing industry, so its results likely meet aspiration and give no cause for problemistic search.
It fits the decorative range and has low carrying costs, so the firm's slack lets it be kept while its results remain uncertain, despite getting only a website mention.
Flame-retardant curtain fabric serves the contract and hospitality segment the firm targets, and its own product page signals strong commitment and performance at or above aspiration.
A wool-blend double-face fabric fits the move toward renewable materials, but blends may conflict with the goal of fewer hard-to-recycle materials; it is kept for now while its results are uncertain.
A wool leno fabric builds on the firm's design strength and sustainability direction, and with healthy industry growth there is no shortfall that calls for redirecting its resources.
